task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to open the chest drawer in the bedroom. And then, recover the old key from the chest drawer. Having got the old key, insert the old key into the wooden door's lock to unlock it. After unlocking the wooden door, make sure that the wooden door is ajar. After that, travel east. And then, make it so that the refrigerator in the kitchen is wide open. Then, recover the bell pepper from the refrigerator. And then, rest the bell pepper on the stove. Got that? Good!
